statement: On the frozen R3 confirmation seeds 4101-4105, the predeclared noise contrast was scored supported and the 40-epoch versus until_residual contrast was scored refuted: the short budget had lower clean risk. Width 4 stayed above the 0.001 training-residual tolerance and width 256 met it. The result applies only to this one-hidden-layer CPU MLP.
limitations: The predeclared 40-epoch versus until_residual contrast is refuted. On seeds 4101-4105, SNR 1, and weight decay 0, epochs_40 minus until_residual clean risk has mean -0.9274205536676664, standard error 0.08318751672019098, minimum -1.1901948155689683, and maximum -0.7294385435323529. The short budget had lower clean risk.
Standard errors are not confidence intervals. They are descriptive across-draw dispersions, with no hypothesis test and no multiplicity adjustment.
The result does not transfer to trees or real tables. It applies only to this one-hidden-layer CPU MLP on confirmation seeds 4101-4105.
scientific_validity remains not_assessed. This is local Cursor team review under the bound authorization, not an external replication.
